title: Getty Center
limitations: The model covers the hilltop museum campus. The lower visitor garage, interstate and tram approach remain viewer map features.

Pavilion plans and open courtyards follow mapped footprints and exterior references. Roof setbacks, service details, outdoor art and the garden planting are simplified. Rooms and collection displays are outside the model scope.
Plaza levels, bridge galleries and garden terraces are approximated from standard Terrarium samples and photographs.
